test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 7 Oct 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Which of the following options best describes the independence of Judiciary?

options.text: The executive and legislative organs of the government must restrain the functioning of the judiciary.
The executive and legislature organs should interfere with the decision of the judiciary.
Judges must be able to perform their functions without fear or favour.
Absence of accountability in the judiciary system

solution:
The correct answer is __**Judges must be able to perform their functions without fear or favour.**__
